We want you to love what you wear. If something isn't quite right, we're here to help.

Our Policy

Unworn, unwashed items with tags attached may be returned or exchanged within 14 days of delivery.

Because our prints are produced in limited quantities, exchanges are always subject to availability.

Final-sale items are noted at checkout and are not eligible for return.

Start a Return

Get in touch with your order number and we'll send you simple return instructions.
